This individual will work exclusively for Turner's Advanced Technology Group, which includes our Data Center, Pharmaceutical, Industrial/Manufacturing, and EV/Battery/Renewables market segment groups (MSG). *** Position Description: Prepare detailed estimates for the project based on the design documents, narratives, and specifications, focusing on the Electrical/Technology/LV System trades. Prepare quantity take-offs, analysis, estimates, and studies for Electrical, Technology, and Low Voltage (LV) system items incorporated in assigned scope from conceptual design through completed construction documents. jobs.description: Position Description: Perform interior and exterior framing and installation of drywall assemblies. Essential Duties Key Responsibilities: Fully comprehend scopes of work per plans and specifications to complete job assignment. Collaborate with Project and/or Trade Foreman for scheduling and expediting delivery of materials and equipment. Transfer layout information from construction drawings and documents to floors or ceilings. Perform installation of rough carpentry, framing, hanging of insulation and drywall, suspended ceiling systems, caulking (e.g., fire and smoke/sound), miscellaneous drywall trim, and rough carpentry. Perform installation of corner bead, j-bead, and l-bead, and other metal trim integral to drywall. Perform installation of door frames (e.g., fully welded or knockdown), doors, and hardware to manufacturer specifications and standards. Perform repairs to doors, frames, walls, and ceilings as required. Coordinate with subcontractors to establish framing requirements. Operate equipment including aerial lifts, forklifts, backhoe, skid steer, excavator, compactors, and construction hoist. Ensure Trade employees, subcontractors, and vendors to comply with Turner standards, safety codes, regulations, and jobsite security. Display high level of teamwork, integrity, commitment, and leadership in daily operations. Fully understand work instructions, project signage, and safety instructions from tool and equipment manufacturers and prepare and inspect tools prior use to ensure safe and working condition. Participate in daily Pre-Task Plans, follow safety expectations for operation of equipment and tools, select appropriate equipment for performing work, adhere to safety protocols to perform work, and wear appropriate PPE (Personal Protection Equipment). Ensure security of equipment and work area while conducting operations. Identify, communicate, and escalate problems and issues to supervisor for immediate resolution. Track production of completed tasks. Maintain positive working relationships with customers, contractors, suppliers and other employees. Other activities, duties, and responsibilities as assigned.

jobs.description: Position Description: Perform carpentry and finishing related to concrete work. Construct and remove formwork for structural, tilt up, and paving concrete; formwork includes job-built forms and/or formwork systems, reveals, chamfers, and pour stops. Read blueprints, sketches and/or building plans to determine dimensions and materials required for form or framing. Establish grades and elevations using builder’s level for concrete work. Erect scaffolding and ladders for assembling structures above ground level. Construct forms and chutes for placing concrete. Construct protection systems. Install block outs and sleeves in elements being formed. Perform setting and tying of rebar as applicable. Prepare and install metal embeds, bolts, and accessories for casting into concrete. Construct provisions for keyways and waterproofing applications. Follow manufacturer instructions to mix bagged concrete for small placements. Chip, scrape, and grind high spots, ridges, and rough projections to finish concrete, use pneumatic chisels, power grinders, or hand tools to achieve desired finish. Operate equipment including forklifts, backhoe, skid steer, excavator, compactors, and construction hoist. Ensure Trade employees, subcontractors, and vendors to comply with Turner standards, safety codes, regulations, and jobsite security. jobs.description: Position Description: Perform interior and exterior framing and installation of drywall assemblies. Essential Duties Key Responsibilities: Fully comprehend scopes of work per plans and specifications to complete job assignment. Transfer layout information from construction drawings and documents to floors or ceilings. Construct provisions for keyways and waterproofing applications. Follow manufacturer instructions to mix bagged concrete for small placements. Chip, scrape, and grind high spots, ridges, and rough projections to finish concrete, use pneumatic chisels, power grinders, or hand tools to achieve desired finish. jobs.title: xPL Production Manager
jobs.description: Position Description: Partner with xPL fabrication facility (“plant”) leadership and superintendents to execute safe, high-quality, and efficient production operations in alignment with plant goals and customer requirements. Lead daily production planning, workflow coordination, and team development for schedule adherence, maximize throughput, and establish zero-incident culture. Serve as key resource to engage teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and on-time fabrication output. Essential Duties Key Responsibilities: Lead, direct, and manage daily production activities of fabrication superintendents and instill adherence to safety, quality, and productivity standards. Plan and coordinate manpower, equipment, and material resources to meet established production schedules and optimize workflow. Drive proactive safety engagement in partnership with Safety team, including daily toolbox talks, hazard assessments, and incident prevention activities. Collaborate with xPL Quality Control (QC) team to maintain first-pass quality and prevent rework, validating production meets specifications and customer requirements. Monitor and analyze production performance metrics, including throughput, cycle time, downtime, and resource utilization; implement corrective actions to support performance. Deliver and maintain communication with plant leadership to align short-term production needs with long-term capacity planning and capital investment strategies. Support Superintendent team development through coaching, training, and performance management; foster culture of accountability and teamwork. Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Logistics, and Maintenance teams to resolve production constraints and maintain operational flow. Oversee clean and organized production areas for compliance with safety and environmental regulations. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow efficiency, equipment utilization, and process standardization. Facilitate pre-shift planning meetings with superintendents to review daily objectives, safety priorities, and quality expectations. Participate in budget planning and cost control efforts related to production operations. Support onboarding and training of new employees to ensure skill readiness and adherence to company standards. Other activities, duties, and responsibilities as assigned.

jobs.title: Laborer Journeyman - Union
jobs.description: Description: Perform tasks involving physical labor at building construction projects. May operate hand and power tools of all types. May clean and prepare sites, dig trenches, set braces to support the sides of excavations, erect scaffolding, and clean up rubble and debris. May assist other craft workers in their trades. Job Tasks: Mop, brush, or spread paints, cleaning solutions or other compounds over surfaces to clean them or to provide protection. Operate jackhammers and drills to break up concrete or pavement. Place, consolidate, and protect case-in-place concrete or masonry structures. Position, join, align, and seal structural components, such as concrete wall sections and pipes. Shovel cement and other materials into portable cement mixers; and mix, pour, and spread concrete. Signal equipment operators to facilitate alignment, movement, and adjustment of machinery, equipment, and materials. Smooth and finish freshly poured cement or concrete, using floats, trowels, screeds, or powered cement finishing tools. Spray materials through hoses to clean, coat, or seal surfaces. Tend machines that pump materials through spray-guns for application to ceilings and walls. Tend pumps, compressors, and generators to provide power for tools, machinery, and equipment. Lubricate, clean, and repair machinery, equipment, and tools. Apply caulking compounds by hand or using caulking guns. Build and position forms for pouring concrete, and dismantle forms after use, using saws, hammers, nails, or bolts. Clean and prepare construction sites to eliminate possible hazards. Dig ditches or trenches, backfill excavations, and compact and level earth to grade specifications, using picks, shovels, pneumatic tampers, and rakes.
